name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 63 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
